rows.en: Touya: "Whoa... Did we get through...?! Where's everyone..."
Touya: "We can't go back... So it's just us from here on..."
Kasumi: "Touya... Are you nervous?"
Touya: "...You're okay with this?"
Kasumi: "Yes. Because I'm with you.
So... I'm not afraid or worried."
Touya: "Kasumi..."
Yamato: "A-ahem!"
Kasumi: "Oh... N-not two of us. Three.
...Sorry, Yamato."
Yamato: "Well, as long as you remember..."
Touya: "...All right, let's go."
Kasumi: "Okay!"
Kasumi: "Is this the 'Core'...?"
Yamato: "It's ridiculously huge..."
Voice: (Welcome to my castle.)
Touya: "?! What the... Straight into my head..."
Kasumi: "Touya, what's wrong?"
Touya: "You can't hear it?"
Kasumi: "Huh? No, I don't hear anything..."
Touya: "I see...
Someone's talking directly into my head right now."
Kasumi: "Directly...?"
Voice: (At last, someone has reached this place...)
Touya: (...Who the hell are you?)
Voice: (Ah, I see... How about this?
Doesn't this voice sound familiar?)
Touya: (That's... Debish!?
You're alive?!)
Voice: (Hahahahaha!)
Touya: (What's so funny?!)
Voice: (...No, pardon me.
Your reasoning was just so simplistic.
I did once reside within him, but I am not him.
Let's see... You can think of me
as a being like that Lin Karma person
who traveled with you.)
Touya: (Disembodied consciousness that can exist after losing its body...)
Voice: (I am something purer and more fundamental.
In any case, you've done very well.
Who would have thought that failure back then would lead to this?)
Touya: (Back then... You mean 109 years ago...)
Voice: (Precisely. I thought it would succeed...
But thanks to that, someone as gifted as you appeared,
so perhaps it wasn't a mistake after all.
They too served me well.
Debish, Lyle, Bernst... And Sharl.
They all devoted themselves to me...)
Touya: (What the hell do you want?)
Voice: (...You humans of the Solar System were truly amusing
creatures.
You can readily sacrifice your own kind for your desires,
yet on the other hand, you try to save them...
It's truly fascinating.
I never tire of watching what you do.
What do you call this...? Ah,
would your world call it 'entertainment'?)
Touya: ('Entertainment'... You say...?)
Voice: (Yes, entertainment.
The way you struggle and suffer... Yet still stand against me.
Nothing can compare to the thrill
of a genuine life-or-death battle... Hehehehe.)
Touya: (Why would you do that?!)
Voice: (Why? What a funny question.
Because I'm bored, obviously.
For us, freed from the bonds of time and able
to create even the future,
ordinary existence is nothing but tedium.
That is why chosen beings like me
indulge in games like this to pass the time.
Yes, wagering the disappearance of our own existence.)
Touya: (You're bored...? You bastard...
For something like that...!!)
Voice: (...Have you ever merely existed
in the aimless passage of time?
Nothing changes. The same time simply flows by...
I too thought that was natural at first.
I never questioned it. But it wasn't so.
When I observed the lives of humans on faraway worlds
beyond our galaxy, living their brief moments,
they brought a time of fulfillment to my empty heart.
They showed me life's radiance by staking their lives,
fighting, and winning. The excitement I felt
was understood by only a very few.
But that doesn't matter.
For now, my time is so fulfilling.)
Touya: (I can't forgive you... Toying with people's lives
to relieve your boredom... I'll never forgive you!!)
Voice: (Good, that's right. Come at me like that.
Humanity's future rests in your hands now.
In that Rayblade you're piloting, to be precise.)
Touya: (What do you mean?)
Voice: (Throughout recorded history, when humanity was in danger,
there was always something to stop the crisis, wasn't there?
Sometimes a person, sometimes a sword,
and sometimes an idea...
Something suited to the age saved humanity.
Haven't you ever wondered
why such convenient things happen?)
Touya: (D-don't tell me...)
Voice: (Yes, it was me. Those fools of Lin Karma
apparently believed they had sealed Vorlia away,
but I could have left that place whenever I wanted.
I remained simply because there was no need to leave.
Above all, that kept them from interfering.
It was convenient for playing with you humans,
who only fix appearances and never learn anything essential.
...And this time, that Rayblade is humanity's
'key' to salvation.
The sole thing capable of stopping this Vorlia.
That's why you could get this far...)
Touya: (...But the fact that we're alive here
means you lost in the past, doesn't it?)
Voice: (No. They failed. They could not even
reach me... So, with their ambitions unfulfilled,
all of them sank into history...)
Touya: (...Then this time I'll end it.)
Voice: (Hehehe... Yes. A wager should be made
on equal terms. If I stay somewhere safe,
I cannot find true enjoyment.
You might call it suspense.
It multiplies the pleasure many times over.
That is why I am giving you a chance.)
Touya: (...)
Voice: (If you destroy this 'Core' with Rayblade,
Vorlia and I will no longer be able to exist, and will disappear.
Then this world will be saved...
Hehehe... Now, may I begin?)
Touya: "..."
Kasumi: "...Is that telepathy, like a psychic power?"
Touya: "..."
Kasumi: "Touya...?"
Touya: "...Huh?"
Kasumi: "What's wrong? You look pale."
Touya: "I was... talking just now..."
Kasumi: "Talking...? Just now?"
Touya: "Yeah."
Kasumi: "But hardly any time has passed.
Probably only a few seconds..."
Touya: "...A few seconds...? I see..."
Voice: (Surprised? I can do this sort of thing too.)
Touya: (...You're one hell of a monster...)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Shall we get started, then...?)
Yamato: "M-meow, what's that?!"
Kasumi: "A black Rayblade...?"
Touya: "...Let's go."
Kasumi: "Huh?"
Touya: "If we beat it, everything will be over."
Kasumi: "...I don't understand, but if you say so, Touya,
it must be all right. Okay. I understand."
Touya: "Sorry."
Kasumi: "No. I believe in you, Touya.
So don't worry about it."
Voice: (...Hm? You're damaged...
It won't be any fun unless you fight
in perfect condition... Very well.)
Kasumi: "What?! The damage... It's repaired..."
Touya: "..."
Voice: (Now, entertain me!)
Touya: (Let's finish this.)
Voice: (Heh... Hehehehehe... Very well.
Then bring it all to an end with your own hands...)
Touya: (I don't need you to tell me!)
Voice: (Good. You're quite entertaining...
But it seems this is as far as you'll get...
Well, some excellent pawns have been moving for me
this time. It's been quite enjoyable... But
it's time for goodbye...)
Voice: (...So you were a disappointment...
You did well until now...
Still, some excellent pawns have been moving for me
this time. It's been quite enjoyable... So
I'll erase you instantly, without pain...)
Touya: "Damn......"
Kasumi: "Touya..."
Voice: (What?! I-impossible... You...!)
Ai: "Touya! Kasumi! Are you all right?!"
Kasumi: "Ai...?"
Clovis: "Hey, looks like you're struggling."
Arthur: "Isn't it unfair
to keep all the glory for yourselves?"
Kasumi: "Everyone..."
Aurelie: "We made it in time, somehow."
Fain: "Now that we're here, you've got nothing to worry about!"
Xiujian: "...Heh."
Melissa: "It's better when we're all together, isn't it?"
Celica: "This is how the finale has to be!"
Gen: "I'll make a cool showing for the finale too!"
Melvi: "I'm here too!"
Voice: (Why... How could you breach that barrier...?)
Rayfon: (Don't underestimate the people of this world.
These humans who have established their 'individuality.'
Individually, they are weak. But when they connect,
they display more strength than you expect...
That is the nature of these humans.
Their imperfection makes them compensate
by cooperating with others. There arises
an unpredictable power that numbers cannot explain.
Trust, friendship, love... It has many forms.
Do you know its name?)
Voice: (...)
Rayfon: (Its name... is 'bonds.'
You believe only in yourselves and trust no one.
No one relies on you, and you love nobody.
I doubt you could understand.)
Voice: (Hehehehe... Hahahahaha!
Amusing. More amusing by the moment!
Very well! I shall give you all the right
to join this wager!)
Voice: (...!? Why?! Why won't they appear?!)
Rishuna: (It's useless. I've cut off this space.
You can no longer summon anything.)
Voice: (Damn...)
Valga: (It's about time this came to an end.)
Voice: (It seems... I underestimated you a little...
But I can also do this...)
Clovis: "What?! What's going on...?"
Arthur: "Illusions...? No, that's not it..."
Xiujian: "...So the final enemy is ourselves..."
Voice: (Now, let the merry festivities begin!!)
Touya: "...We're aiming for that black one."
Kasumi: "Okay."
Touya: "...I don't know what'll happen.
But will you come with me?"
Kasumi: "...Of course. Even if you tell me not to,
I'll follow you. I'm not leaving your side, you know."
Touya: "Kasumi..."
Kasumi: "Touya, Yamato... Let's go.
No matter what happens, we'll be together..."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Clovis: "Th-this is..."
Fain: "Oh!"
Celica: "I can't believe it..."
Touya: "...Here we go!!"
Kasumi: "Everyone!"
Ai: "Touya! Kasumi! Are you all right?!"
Clovis: "Are you both safe?!"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Xiujian: "...It seems the battle is decided."
Yamato: "...I'm here too, you know..."
Voice: (...Excellent... You have entertained me quite well...)
Touya: (It's over now.)
Voice: (Hehehehehe... Yes...
But this doesn't end everything...)
Touya: (...What do you mean...?)
Voice: (I will indeed disappear.
But unless you make the Core cease to exist,
you cannot stop Vorlia...)
Touya: (What?!)
Voice: (...That was enjoyable...
Experiencing destruction isn't so bad... after all...)
Touya: (W-wait! How can I make the Core disappear?!)
Voice: (...I told you Rayblade is the key...
You must figure out what to do for yourself...)
Touya: (The key... Myself...)
Voice: (...Hehehehe... It's a pity I cannot
watch to the very end, but I wish you luck... Farewell...)
Kasumi: "Huh? Wh-what...?"
Yamato: "Is Vorlia moving?
What in the meow...?"
Touya: "...Tch. It won't even let me think..."
Kasumi: "..."
Touya: "...Listen to me."
Yamato: "Huh? Why are you switching to transmit mode?
Hey. Hey, Tou..."
Kasumi: "...Don't."
Yamato: "Huh?"
Kasumi: "...I'm sure Touya has something in mind.
Let's trust him, okay?"
Yamato: "O-okay..."
Touya: "...I'm going to destroy Vorlia's Core.
But only this Rayblade can do it.
So I want you to go back ahead of us."
Fain: "Hey! What the hell do you mean?!"
Touya: "...I know it's selfish to say this
after we've come so far.
But it's not because I don't believe in you.
I want you to go back because I believe in you, because I trust you.
And let me feel sure that I have a place to return to,
a place I have to return to..."
Clovis: "Hey, you can't say that after we've come this far.
We're staying with you to the end."
Xiujian: "Heh... Do you think we'll simply obey
when you tell us to leave? I haven't sunk so low
that I'd dump it all on a comrade and leave by myself."
Arthur: "How cold... I'll be with you to the end."
Fain: "What are you saying?! I'll stick with you to the end too!"
Rayfon: "We should calmly face the facts.
There's nothing we can do as we are.
It's frustrating... But it's true.
We shouldn't make this any harder for him.
If we really believe in him, if we're really his comrades,
we should leave this to him."
Rayfon: "...But you have to keep
your promise to return."
Touya: "...Yeah. I'll try."
Clovis: "Touya... No, never mind.
It's only a brief parting."
Touya: "...I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Clovis: "Yeah. Don't die!"
Xiujian: "......I won't say goodbye."
Touya: "Yeah... I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Xiujian: "...Understood."
Arthur: "...I won't say farewell."
Touya: "Yeah. Neither will I."
Arthur: "...Be careful..."
Fain: "......Damn!"
Touya: "I'm counting on you to handle things back there."
Fain: "...A-all right! But don't you dare die!
That's a promise!"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Ai: "Listen, you're coming back... You absolutely are..."
Touya: "...Don't worry. I'm just going for a little while."
Ai: "H-hmph! I-I'm worried about Kasumi!
You'd better bring her back safely!"
Kasumi: "Ai..."
Ai: "...Kasumi, take care of Touya."
Kasumi: "...Okay. Leave him to me."
Ai: "Hehehe... See you, then."
Touya: "...Well then, let's go."
Yamato: "Go...?"
Kasumi: "...Are you going to use Rayblade itself?"
Touya: "Oh, you really do get it."
Kasumi: "You looked so troubled, Touya.
But... Rayblade will be destroyed."
Touya: "You don't think we'll fail?"
Kasumi: "Even if we do fail, as long as I'm with you,
I'll have no regrets..."
Touya: "...Kasumi..."
Kasumi: "Wh-what?"
Touya: "Want to come over here?"
Kasumi: "Huh? But what about piloting...?"
Touya: "We aren't fighting, and I can handle
the piloting from here alone... Don't you want to?"
Kasumi: "...I do."
Touya: "Are you okay? Be careful."
Kasumi: "...It's like last time..."
Touya: "Yeah... But now we need each other more than anyone else.
It's different from before."
Kasumi: "...Yeah.
...Can I hold your hand?"
Touya: "Yeah."
Kasumi: "Maybe you're right.
But we'll never succeed if we give up from the start..."
Touya: "...You've gotten stronger."
Kasumi: "You've toughened me up, Touya."
Touya: "???"
Kasumi: "Hehehehehe."
Touya: "...Shall we go...?"
Kasumi: "...Okay..."
Touya: "It's all right. We'll always be together.
...Here we go!"
Touya: "Uooooooooh!!"

review_batches.context: Read all353 rows plus complete Celica/Aurelie finale variants and the earlier Ai finale for context. Kasumi reassures Touya, apologizes to Yamato for implying two rather than three, and cannot hear the concealed Voice's direct mental speech.
review_batches.decisions: Keep this Kasumi partner route separate. Preserve source Voice label and mental parentheses versus spoken quotes. Voice's Debish inhabiting, 109-year failure, human nature and self-existence wager remain its claims. Keep all deliberately incomplete thoughts and noun phrases; no library identity, named Lin Karma companion or new physical action added.

row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o008ee.p01.l00: Source we not a claim every alien shares pastime.

review_batches.context: Same full reading. Voice's history/game claims and Rayblade/Core explanation; Kasumi suggests telepathy and reports only seconds, then agrees to support Touya; repair and combat events begin.
review_batches.decisions: Don't convert claims about all history or voluntary sealing into narrator facts. Core means Vorlia's central component; no runtime mapping to numbered Core units proved. Earlier challengers failed to reach Voice according to it. Kasumi's telepathy is a question and seconds a rough estimate. Mech damage repair is distinct from a guaranteed medical cure.

row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o009e3.p01.l08: Only a few, no unsupported majority.
row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o00e40.l00: They means earlier challengers, not Voice.
row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o00ec1.p01.l00: Explicit subject and verb restored for naming suspense.

review_batches.context: Same full reading. Alternate failure taunts, rescue, Rayfon's bonds argument, local summoning block, mirrored foes and Kasumi's promise never to leave Touya/Yamato; apparent battle conclusion.
review_batches.decisions: Retain failure/success triggers as separate conditions, every arriving ally and Yamato's overlooked-third gag. No exact numeric bonds mechanic, named summons or confirmed illusion method. Kasumi's commitment includes Yamato and is nonexplicit affection. Each repeated source physical row remains separate.

row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o01c17.l00: Bonds is a thematic concept, not formal attack.
row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o0206b.l01: She refuses separation, no forced sexual content.

review_batches.context: Same full reading. Voice warns Core remains active, Vorlia moves, Kasumi stops Yamato's interruption, Touya requests others return and Rayfon persuades them. Ai insists on safe return and entrusts Touya to Kasumi.
review_batches.decisions: Opponent defeat is not Core destruction. Kasumi tells Yamato not to interrupt, not Touya not to transmit. Preserve explicit aid direction in all entrustments, trust versus abandonment, promise versus guaranteed survival, and Ai's embarrassed claim she worries about Kasumi. No solution or fate invented.

row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o023f5.l01: Voice defeat does not stop Core.
row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o02755.l02: Others return ahead of Rayblade occupants.
row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o027df.l05: Touya asks reassurance of a place to return, not offers help.
row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o028f2.l02: Xiujian refuses to dump burden on Touya.
row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o0295b.l00: Brief complaint plus explicit I promise.
row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o02b82.l00: Touya entrusts departing allies with matters back there; likewise301/307.
row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o02de2.l00: Ai's embarrassed denial, not narrator negation of concern for Touya.
row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o02e3c.l00: Ai asks Kasumi to care for Touya.

review_batches.context: Same full reading. Kasumi infers using Rayblade itself, anticipates destruction, moves over at Touya's invitation and asks to hold hands before the charge. Separate encouragement response remains in physical order.
review_batches.decisions: Her no-regrets answer to possible failure is not a suicide instruction or confirmed death. Piloting from Touya's station is his claim. Ordinary hand-holding and reciprocal need are explicit; add no sexual action. Rows342-343 appear to be an alternate reassurance response; do not invent a missing preceding pessimistic line or merge it into another partner's speech.

row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o02f82.l01: Conditional no-regrets claim, no confirmed fate.
row_decisions.scenario.s_03b.o03012.l01: Touya says he can pilot from his side.
